# Author Review Checklist: Dialogue Exercise Redesign

**Purpose**: General requirements quality and completeness validation for the author before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are exact rendering conditions for the "Earlier" row documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are validation bounds (min/max counts) specified for beats and decision options? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the exact data fields required to be saved in the session explicitly listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the concatenation format of the "Earlier" summary row completely unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the privacy constraints regarding what NOT to store (therapeutic text) explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the behavior of unchosen decision options specifically defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do the VoiceOver live-region requirements consistently cover transitions for both passive and decision beats? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the data model entities align seamlessly with the UI constraints defined in the spec? [Consistency, Data Model]

## Interaction & Accessibility Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for the visibility of the primary action button vs. the "Skip for now" button during a pending decision? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it clear what VoiceOver should announce when the exercise state is restored? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the haptic feedback requirements documented for interactive elements? [Coverage, Assumptions]

## Edge Case & Error Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for how the engine handles corrupted or out-of-bounds saved indices? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the engine's fallback behavior specified if malformed content reaches it at runtime? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the UI and state mutation requirements specified for when the exercise is in a locked/read-only mode? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
